died.name: Louis-Joseph de Montcalm
died.cause: on being told the wound he had received at the Battle of the Plains of Abraham was mortal
died.last_words: So much the better. I am happy that I shall not live to see the surrender of Quebec. I have much business that must be attended to of greater moment than your ruined garrison and this wretched country.

died.name: William McKinley
died.cause: dying after being shot on 6 September
died.last_words: Goodbye, all, goodbye. It is God's way. His will be done.

died.name: Isadora Duncan
died.cause: just before dying in freak car accident The 50-year-old American dancer broke her neck in Nice, when her long scarf became entangled in the open-spoked wheel and rear axle of the Amilcar CGSS automobile in which she was riding.
died.last_words: Farewell, my friends. I go to glory!
